{{Top|leg}}
'''The Pit''' was the name attributed to an abandoned tunnel offshoot on the [[Kessel prison|Imperial Correctional Facility]], which was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. It was near the slave quarters, and was converted by the trustee [[Moruth Doole]] into a solitary confinement cell by installing a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] door.<ref name="kessel">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030501kessel|text=Kessel: Hell in Space|int=Kessel: Hell in Space}}</ref>

When Doole had the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] prisoner [[Gyylghrard]] beaten by his [[Security guard/Legends|guards]], the injured Wookiee was thrown into the Pit for almost a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] without any food or spare [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] for his breather equipment.<ref name="kessel" />
